capability.title: Brand & Compliance Governance
capability.summary: The gate every publish-bound item passes through. Runs the cheap deterministic checks first, escalates only what needs judgement, and decides — from policy, not from the caller's optimism — whether a human sees this before the public does.

observability.slo: 100% of publish-bound items pass through this subsystem

with.note: Cheapest and most absolute first. A rights failure cannot be argued past by any later step.
Regulated verticals bind to the strict screen. One line in a profile, no branch here.

assignments.note: An expired approval parks. Silence is never consent.
